translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Rom

content: AGot inor len nǝ-sab̃-sǝhoti-an san gail

Gaiug gotosab̃ sǝhoti ke nǝvanuan tile am timaspanis, gǝsalǝboi gǝb̃etǝtas gol gaiug, husur gaiug am gusa sum̃an galito. Nǝboŋ gotosab̃ sǝhoti ke avan ideh timaspanis husur nǝsaan san, be gaiug gusab̃ sǝhoti ke gaiug am gimaspanis, husur gaiug gugol nǝsaan top̃itp̃itoṽ.
Datolǝboii ke, nǝboŋ aGot tosab̃ sǝhoti ke nǝvanuan limaspanis sil lotogol natenan, nǝ-sab̃-sǝhoti-an san inor hǝn nakitinan.
Imagenan, gaiug, nǝboŋ gotosab̃ sǝhoti ke galit limaspanis be gaiug gohusur naṽide top̃itoṽ hum galito, gunau ke gotolǝboi gǝb̃igam yav dan nǝpanismen siGot a? Ao!

Gǝsalǝboii ke aGot tovoi masuṽ hǝn gaiug a? Gai satutut hǝn b̃emǝtahun gaiug; len nasusumaran, itoh mǝdau mai gaiug. Gǝsalǝboii a? Hum ma natgalenan lǝsavi natideh len gaiug. AGot ivoi hǝn gaiug hǝn b̃esǝhar gaiug van hǝn nǝpairan dan nǝsaan, gǝsǝnau sǝhoti a?

Be gaiug guhaihai, nǝkadum̃ iṽonṽon, gomǝtahun gǝb̃ipair dan nǝsaan sam̃. Bathut gotomaienan gugol ke nǝpanismen sam̃ gabag evivi mǝhat am, husur nǝboŋ hǝn nǝlol paŋpaŋ dereh tegǝmai. Evi nǝboŋ aGot b̃ikel vǝhot nǝ-sab̃-sǝhoti-an san tonor, mai nǝpanismen.
AGot dereh tilav nap̃urp̃uran mai nǝvanuan p̃isi tinor hǝn nǝsa lotogole.
Dereh tilav nǝmauran vi sutuai mai alat lotosusumar hǝn lǝb̃igol navoian, lotodaŋ len aGot hǝn b̃eviol hǝn nǝyalyalan, nǝ-sal-suh-galito-an mai nǝmauran topat vi sutuai.
Be len nab̃iltilol paŋpaŋ san, dereh nǝlon aGot tepǝŋas alat lotonau galit sǝb̃olito ŋai, lǝsagol nǝsa nakitinan tokele, be lotopul hǝn nǝsaan len nǝmauran salito.
Na-lǝŋon-isa-vǝsa-an mai nǝmauran todaŋ dereh aribar nǝvanuan p̃isi lotogolgol nǝsaan: naJu gail a m̃o, beti alat lǝsavi Ju.
Be alat lotogolgol navoian, dereh aGot tisal suh galito, teputsan nahǝsalito, teriŋ natǝm̃at len nǝlolito: naJu gail a m̃o, beti alat lǝsavi Ju.
Husur naṽide siGot ep̃itoṽ van hǝn nǝvanuan p̃isi, ideh satile.
Alat lǝsǝkad nalo siGot be lotogol nǝsaan, dereh limasig naut kǝmas lǝsǝkad nalo. Avil alat lotokad nalo be lotogol nǝsaan, nalo dereh tisab̃ sǝhoti ke limaspanis.
Husur savi alat lotosǝsǝloŋ hǝn nalo aGot togol lotonor len nǝhon; be alat lotogol nǝsa nalo tokele, dereh aGot teriŋi ke galit linor len nǝhon.
Husur, alat lǝsavi Ju lǝsǝkad nalo siGot, lǝb̃ehusur nab̃oruan salito ale gol nǝsa nalo tokele, ehum lotokad nalo len nǝlolito, naut kǝmas lǝsasǝsǝloŋ hǝni boŋ ideh.
Len naṽide salito imasil ke aGot totos gat nalo len nǝlolito, husur nǝlolit gail mai nǝnauan salit sǝb̃olit arukel vǝhot nǝsaan mai galito o arukel mai galit ke lotonor.

Dereh aGot tigol natgalenan len nǝboŋ b̃epǝpehun navoian dan nǝsaan len natit gail nǝvanuan p̃isi lotosusuani. Napǝpehunian enan, dereh teriŋi len navǝlan aKristo aYesu, hum na-kel-uri-an sagw tovoi tokele.
NaJu gail mai nalo
Be gaiug gotovi Ju, gumabe? Gaiug gudaŋ len nalo siGot, gusor patpat gaiug mǝhat hum aGot tovi amaheam̃.
Gaiug golǝboi nǝsa Nasub̃ tolǝŋoni, golǝboi nǝsa tonor mai nǝsa tosa husur nalo san eṽusan gaiug.
Len nǝnauan sam̃ gunau suluṽi ke gotolǝboi gǝb̃esǝhar nǝvanuan gail, lotovi metb̃esw len nǝnauan salito. Gunau suluṽi ke gotohum nam̃ial tolǝboi b̃em̃ias nap̃isal m̃os alat lototoh len nǝmargobut.
Gunau suluṽi ke gotovi hai p̃usan m̃os alat lotovi hoṽon mai alat lǝsǝmatmatu len nadǝlomian salito. Gaiug gotovi Ju gunau maien hǝni husur gukad nalo siGot tovi nǝkadun nalǝboian mai nakitinan.
Imaienan, gǝb̃eṽusan avan ideh gail, imabe gǝsaṽusan gaiug gabag? Gukel uri ke, “Samtevǝnvǝnah!” be gaiug, govǝnvǝnah a?
Gukele ke, “Samtigol naitian tob̃ur kotov nǝlahan!” be gaiug, gugol naitian tob̃ur kotov nǝlahan a? Gaiug gomǝtahun bun nǝlablab gail, be naim nalotuan hǝn nǝlablab gail, govǝnah lan a?
Gaiug gusor patpat nalo siGot mǝhat, be gob̃ur kokotov nalo enan mǝdas nahǝsan aGot a?
Husur natosian siGot ike, “Gamit mǝttovi Ju, naluṽoh hǝn nǝvanuan naut tiltile lusor mǝdas nahǝsan aGot sil gamito.”

Gǝb̃igol husur nǝsa nalo siGot tokele, na-tiv-dalusi-an seJu evi natit tovoi husur ipat len nalo. Be gǝb̃eb̃ur kokotov nalo, na-tiv-dalusi-an sam̃ savi natideh. Ehum gǝsavi Ju. Ehum gǝsǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an len gaiug boŋ ideh.
Imagenan, alat lǝsǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an, galit lǝb̃igol husur nǝsa nalo tokele, len nabunusian siGot esum̃an lotokad na-tiv-dalusi-an tia, esum̃an lotovi Ju gail.
Ale alat lotogol husur nǝsa nalo tokele be lǝsǝkad na-tiv-dalusi-an, galit dereh lisab̃ sǝhoti ke, gaiug gotovi Ju gotokad na-tiv-dalusi-an, gimaspanis husur gukad nalo be gob̃ur kokotovi.
Savi nǝpasian o na-tiv-dalusi-an nǝvanuan tokade len niben togol tovi Ju kitin.

Ao. NaJu kitin evi Ju m̃au len nǝlon. Ale na-tiv-dalusi-an kitin evi na-tiv-dalusi-an hǝn nǝlon. Na-gol-husur-nalo-an edǝdas b̃igol na-tiv-dalusi-an kitin len nǝlon, ao, aNunun aGot igole. Ale dereh aGot tisal suh nǝvanuan tomaienan. Nǝvanuan gail asike lǝb̃isal suhi, be aGot m̃au dereh tisal suhi.

footnotes.text: 2.1 Mat 7.1; Luk 6.37. Len naut egai aPol esivoh len naJu gail husur lupatpat galit mǝhat sǝhor alat lǝsavi Ju.
2.22 Deu 7.25. NaJu gail lomǝtahun nǝlablab husur nalo siGot tokai tasi, be lovǝnoh natit topat len naim nalotuan silablab gail, ale lohǝhaṽur hǝn nǝvat lotokade len nǝboŋ lotop̃ur hǝni.
2.29 Deu 30.6. Len nasoruan Ipru namilen Ju o Jutah evi nǝ-sal-suhi-an. Gen 29.35.
